input_equivalence.command:
python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,subprocess,datetime; from pathlib import Path
root=Path(".").resolve(); phase=root/".planning/phases/174-packaged-proof-delivery-handoff"; c=subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()
assert c=="9b8cf54dc7e457e2264a15901b011d0c70a1ed8c",c
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","cat-file","-t",c],text=True).strip()=="commit"
subprocess.run(["git","merge-base","--is-ancestor",c,"HEAD"],check=True)
g=lambda *a:subprocess.check_output(["git",*a])
commits=g("rev-list",c+"..HEAD").decode().splitlines()
def paths(*args): return [x.decode("utf-8","surrogateescape") for x in g(*args).split(bytes([0])) if x]
committed=[]
for rev in commits:
 committed += paths("diff-tree","--root","--no-commit-id","--name-only","--no-renames","-r","-m","-z",rev)
staged=paths("diff","--cached","--name-only","--no-renames","-z")
unstaged=paths("diff","--name-only","--no-renames","-z")
untracked=paths("ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard","-z")
assert not (committed or staged or unstaged or untracked),(committed,staged,unstaged,untracked)
freeze=json.loads((phase/"174-INPUT-FREEZE.json").read_text())
assert len(freeze["files"])==63
assert all(hashlib.sha256((root/x["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==x["sha256"] for x in freeze["files"])
proof=json.loads((phase/"174-PACKAGE-PROOF.json").read_text())
idx=hashlib.sha256((phase/"174-PROOF-INDEX.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert idx=="fefc13619dda61b0617cc2fad445f887652edaba42ffaad5d988cb43650e8fb8",idx
assert proof["source_revision"]=="73bb46811f4b76b2372b4af2b4e21aaf42893ac1"
assert proof["counts"]=={"executed":12,"failed":0,"passed":12,"skipped":0}
print(json.dumps({"observed_at":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),"candidate_sha":c,"observed_head":c,"candidate_reachable":True,"intervening_commits":commits,"committed_delta_paths":committed,"staged_paths":staged,"unstaged_paths":unstaged,"nonignored_untracked_paths":untracked,"frozen_input_file_count":len(freeze["files"]),"frozen_input_hashes_match":True,"proof_index_sha256":idx,"package_source_revision":proof["source_revision"],"package_counts":proof["counts"],"status":"passed"},sort_keys=True))'
